description: Sign in and read one page of ChatGPT Ads Manager as text — campaign lists, account settings, billing state. Only paths on ads.openai.com are allowed. This is screen reading, not an API: the answer is whatever the page said, capped, and it is labelled channel=browser.

path.description: Path on the Ads Manager, e.g. "/campaigns". Defaults to "/".

name: chatgpt_ads_browser_read
